name: VTK-Based Transfer Function Application
definition: A method for applying color and opacity transfer functions using VTK classes (`vtkLookupTable` and `vtkPiecewiseFunction`) to map scalar values to RGBA components.
summary: VTK-Based Transfer Function Application maps scalar volume data to RGBA values using VTK's optimized lookup tables and piecewise functions, distinguishing itself by relying on VTK's internal interpolation logic rather than custom code.
